summary: Completed Module 01 STEP 3: BUILD. Diagnosed and fixed Bug #1 (PostgreSQL container stopped, verified via pg_isready and port 5432 listener) and Bug #2 (pagination off-by-one and unstable ordering, resolved by implementing page-based offset calculation offset = (page - 1) * limit and adding deterministic secondary sort tie-breaker Link.id.desc()). Maintained complete diagnosis notes in progress/module-01-diagnosis.md and verified three-page curl pagination with zero overlap.
evidence: Diagnosed Bug #1 with two hypotheses; resolved by starting existing container upsk-sdf-postgres without data loss
Verified PostgreSQL readiness: docker exec pg_isready confirmed accepting connections and port 5432 listening
Diagnosed Bug #2 with two hypotheses; resolved by implementing page-based offset calculation (page - 1) * limit in apps/api/app/routers/links.py
Added deterministic tie-breaker sorting .order_by(Link.created_at.desc(), Link.id.desc()) to prevent nondeterministic pagination
Verified 3-page pagination via curl: Page 1 (IDs 811-802), Page 2 (IDs 801-792), Page 3 (IDs 791-782) with 0 duplicate items across boundaries
Preserved backward compatibility for skip parameter and verified tenant scoping and 401 unauthenticated protection
Maintained complete diagnostic notes and proof in progress/module-01-diagnosis.md
